name: Keysight IxFlow | Inventory
description: Inventory of endpoints, services and applications discovered by Keysight IxFlow.

header.title: Client Endpoints
header.description: Distinct client IP addresses seen by IxFlow.

config.name: IxFlow | INV Client Endpoints

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixDcClientIp=dc(clientIp) unwind=true | limit 1000

config.description: Distinct client IP addresses seen by IxFlow.

header.title: Server Endpoints
header.description: Distinct server IP addresses seen by IxFlow.

config.name: IxFlow | INV Server Endpoints

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixDcServerIp=dc(serverIp) unwind=true | limit 1000

config.description: Distinct server IP addresses seen by IxFlow.

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixDcServerPort=dc(serverPort) unwind=true | limit 1000
ixApplication != null | aggr ixDcIxApplication=dc(ixApplication) unwind=true | limit 1000
ixApplication != null | aggr ixDcIxOsDeviceName=dc(ixOsDeviceName) unwind=true | limit 1000
ixApplication != null | aggr ixDcIxClientAsName=dc(ixClientAsName) unwind=true | limit 1000

hideTooMuchData.message: To protect browser performance output records limit was imposed on the widget. Please apply filters or narrow down analysed time frame to display the results.

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixDcClientIp=dc(clientIp) by ixOsDeviceName as ixOsDeviceName unwind=true | sort ixDcClientIp desc | limit 8

hideTooMuchData.message: To protect browser performance output records limit was imposed on the widget. Please apply filters or narrow down analysed time frame to display the results.

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixDcServerIp=dc(serverIp) by ixServerIpCountryName as ixServerIpCountryName unwind=true | sort ixDcServerIp desc | limit 8

hideTooMuchData.message: To protect browser performance output records limit was imposed on the widget. Please apply filters or narrow down analysed time frame to display the results.

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixDcServerIp=dc(serverIp) by ixApplication as ixApplication unwind=true | sort ixDcServerIp desc | limit 8

header.title: Client Inventory
header.description: Every client endpoint with OS, country, AS, first/last seen and usage.

config.name: IxFlow | INV Client Inventory

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixFirstSeen=min(firstTimestamp), ixLastSeen=max(timestamp), ixDcIxApplication=dc(ixApplication), ixDcServerIp=dc(serverIp), ixFlows=sum(flows), ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes) by clientIp as clientIp, ixOsDeviceName as ixOsDeviceName, ixClientIpCountryName as ixClientIpCountryName, ixClientAsName as ixClientAsName unwind=true | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb) | sort ixBytes desc | limit 500

config.description: Every client endpoint with OS, country, AS, first/last seen and usage.

header.title: Server Inventory
header.description: Every server endpoint with location, services, clients, first/last seen.

config.name: IxFlow | INV Server Inventory

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixFirstSeen=min(firstTimestamp), ixLastSeen=max(timestamp), ixDcServerPort=dc(serverPort), ixDcIxApplication=dc(ixApplication), ixDcClientIp=dc(clientIp), ixFlows=sum(flows), ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes) by serverIp as serverIp, ixServerIpCountryName as ixServerIpCountryName, ixServerIpRegionName as ixServerIpRegionName, ixServerIpCityName as ixServerIpCityName unwind=true | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb) | sort ixBytes desc | limit 500

config.description: Every server endpoint with location, services, clients, first/last seen.

header.title: Services
header.description: Server port / protocol / application combinations and their usage.

config.name: IxFlow | INV Services

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixDcServerIp=dc(serverIp), ixDcClientIp=dc(clientIp), ixFlows=sum(flows), ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes), ixLastSeen=max(timestamp) by serverPort as serverPort, protocol as protocolName, ixApplication as ixApplication unwind=true | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb) | sort ixFlows desc | limit 500

config.description: Server port / protocol / application combinations and their usage.
